stoppingPoint.summary: Qt Core container domain model with recursive splits, pages, activation, detachment normalization, validation, and schema-versioned JSON persistence; validated profile and theme schemas; the Qt Quick shell preview; the scenario harness; and the documentation policy are complete and recorded in the roadmap.

evidence.summary: The public roadmap records Foundation as Complete.
The testing harness records the standing compiler, unit, documentation, and source-policy gates.

features.title: Compositor MVP

stoppingPoint.summary: Tracked KWin 6.6.5 base, nested Wayland session, rootless XWayland, output/input inventories, the atomic container-control protocol, and dynamic plugin-unload recovery are qualified; the complete live workflow passed ten consecutive stress repetitions.

evidence.summary: The public roadmap records Compositor MVP as Complete.
Debug/Release and repeated private nested workflow evidence is recorded in the testing harness.

features.caveat: Finished user interaction and physical hardware qualification belong to later milestones.

features.title: Hybrid interaction

stoppingPoint.summary: Process-local pointer/keyboard docking, native-decoration detach, split/page reorganization, focus/transient policy, restore, live decoration proof, and grouped plugin-unload restoration passed final qualification with clean Debug/Release registries, focused suites, ASan+UBSan, and repeated private live workflows.

evidence.summary: The public roadmap records Hybrid interaction as Complete.
The focused Hybrid selectors and private live workflows are the authoritative acceptance record.

features.caveat: Persisted login topology, mixed-DPI migration, and physical input/DRM/GPU coverage remain later Platform or Release gates.

evidence.summary: Production resolution and the two live built-ins are documented.

steps.caveat: Each applet requires a least-authority service boundary, real presentation, and interaction proof.

Installed live notification interaction remains incomplete.

evidence.summary: The deterministic production LayerShell surface proof is integrated on public main; independent and manager verification each passed the 1080p, WUXGA, and 1440p private nested matrix.
The public roadmap marks Shell and customization In progress and names the integrated production boundaries.
The public task list names Live notification interaction qualification as the active outcome.
The public handoff defines the private nested acceptance boundary and host-containment rules.

features.caveat: The production surface/work-area proof is qualified, but live notification shortcut/focus/DND/lock interaction, global menu, reveal UI, task/launcher/tray, WYSIWYG customization, and many remaining experiences are not complete.

features.title: Platform services

steps.title: Audio device, default, and stream control
steps.summary: The typed Audio1 stack, resident WirePlumber adapter, lifecycle, package, and isolated null-device runtime are integrated, while physical devices and desktop UI remain unqualified.

evidence.summary: The accepted Audio1 stack is integrated.
Debug/Release, sanitizer, package, activation, lifecycle, and containment evidence are recorded.

steps.caveat: Physical microphone/speaker, USB/HDMI/Bluetooth/jack/multichannel, suspend/hotplug/resource behavior, and Settings/shell UI remain.

steps.title: Display inventory and reversible output transactions
steps.summary: No integrated Display service lets users identify, arrange, enable, rotate, scale, mirror, preview, confirm, or revert outputs.

evidence.summary: Display remains the next source-only platform boundary rather than an integrated outcome.

steps.caveat: D0/D1 worker candidates and compile activity add zero until accepted manager integration.

steps.title: Power status/actions and coherent brightness
steps.summary: No integrated provider exposes batteries, charging, profiles, inhibitors, safe session power actions, display brightness, or keyboard backlight.

evidence.summary: Power and brightness remain later platform outcomes.

steps.caveat: Current architecture analysis is planning evidence only.

steps.title: Network connectivity
steps.summary: No integrated model lets users see connectivity, scan, connect/disconnect known networks, or control radios.

evidence.summary: Network remains a later platform outcome.

steps.caveat: Provider reuse, scan leases, secrets, owner replacement, and offline behavior remain.

steps.title: Bluetooth devices
steps.summary: No integrated provider lets users inspect adapters/devices, discover, connect, disconnect, or handle pairing safely.

evidence.summary: Bluetooth remains a later platform outcome.

steps.caveat: A generic boolean setting and applet capability name are prerequisites, not Bluetooth product behavior.

steps.title: Private bounded clipboard history
steps.summary: No integrated clipboard/history service provides bounded, searchable, lock-private history while preserving ordinary Wayland clipboard behavior.

evidence.summary: Clipboard remains a later platform outcome.

steps.caveat: The generic clipboardHistory setting does not implement capture, privacy, purge, or UI.

steps.title: Display color, ICC, HDR, and WCG settings
steps.summary: No integrated color provider supports profile discovery/import/assignment or truthful compositor application.

evidence.summary: Color remains inside the incomplete Platform services milestone.

steps.caveat: Design-token color math is not display color management.

steps.title: Font discovery and confirmed first-party application
steps.summary: No integrated font catalog/application provider proves that first-party apps apply family, size, antialiasing, hinting, or subpixel policy before UI construction.

evidence.summary: Font settings remain inside the incomplete Platform services milestone.

steps.caveat: Settings1 keys are prerequisites, not font discovery or confirmed toolkit application.

steps.title: Portal interoperability and desktop policy export
steps.summary: No integrated portal boundary qualifies chooser, URI, notification, inhibit, screencast/remote-desktop, consent, or QindaQt appearance export.

evidence.summary: Portals and policy remain part of the incomplete Platform services milestone.

steps.caveat: Existing service-specific authentication and the installed KDE portal ecosystem are prerequisites only.

stoppingPoint.summary: The bounded org.qindaqt.Audio1 protocol, asynchronous Qt client, resident service, confined WirePlumber worker, deterministic reset lifecycle, and isolated null-device runtime/package qualification are integrated on public main. Display1 transaction and compositor-output candidates are preserved but not integrated.

evidence.summary: The bounded Audio1 platform milestone is integrated.
The public handoff records Debug/Release, sanitizer, package, activation, lifecycle, documentation, and host-containment evidence.
The public roadmap marks Platform services In progress.

features.caveat: Power, brightness, Bluetooth, network, clipboard, display/color/font providers, portals, policy, physical hardware, and Audio UI/hardware qualification remain. This large milestone is not called executable from one integrated provider.

features.title: Release qualification

stoppingPoint.summary: The next integration threshold is a bootable, interactable, screenshot-qualified QindaQt desktop in a completely private nested Wayland environment. Physical hardware, the initial 1,024 MiB aggregate idle PSS and 1% idle CPU budgets, migrations, distribution packaging, recovery, and upgrade qualification remain planned; existing component-level nested evidence does not satisfy the whole-desktop threshold.

evidence.summary: The public roadmap lists Release qualification as Planned.
The active product outcome defines isolated boot, interaction, screenshot, resolution/DPI, host-containment, and initial 1,024 MiB PSS acceptance.
ADR-0015 makes functional virtual-desktop qualification precede aggressive memory refinement.

features.caveat: No whole-desktop nested-session or daily-use release claim exists; this row remains zero until that integrated behavior is executable and evidenced.
